meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 安装并启动 claude-mem:在 Cursor 中执行安装命令,启动本地或远程 worker,并让 Claude 通过 MCP 服务(claude-mem-local/claude-mem-remote)连接该 worker。
howto.when: 当你在 Cursor 里要设置 claude-mem 时使用,例如选择本地或远程 worker、配置本机 host-login 观察器或使用远程推理等场景。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem,用默认本地模式。
say.note: 执行默认安装命令,启动本地 worker。

say.text: 我要装远程 worker,服务器地址是 https://example.com。
say.note: 按远程模式安装并设置服务器 URL。

say.text: 把 claude-mem 配置成 host 本机登录方式。
say.note: 使用 host provider 的本地转发。

howto.what_en: Installs and starts claude-mem: run the installer in Cursor, start a local or remote worker, and let Claude connect to it via MCP (claude-mem-local/claude-mem-remote).
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem in Cursor, e.g., choosing a local or remote worker, configuring local host-login observer, or using remote inference.

say_en.text: Help me install claude-mem in Cursor with the default local mode.
say_en.note: Runs the default install and starts the local worker.

say_en.text: I want a remote worker; server URL is https://example.com.
say_en.note: Installs remote mode and sets the server URL.

say_en.text: Configure claude-mem with the host local-login method.
say_en.note: Uses the host provider loopback shim.
